question: IBM의 영업현금흐름과 CAPEX를 알려줘.
pipeline_answer:

| 회계연도 | 영업현금흐름 | CAPEX |

| 2016-12-31 | 17,084 [Cash_Flow Cell A9438] | -3,567 [Cash_Flow Cell A9464] |

| 2018-12-31 | 15,247 [Cash_Flow Cell A9442] | -3,395 [Cash_Flow Cell A9468] |
| 2019-12-31 | 14,770 [Cash_Flow Cell A9444] | -2,286 [Cash_Flow Cell A9470] |
| 2020-12-31 | 18,197 [Cash_Flow Cell A9446] | -2,618 [Cash_Flow Cell A9472] |
| 2021-12-31 | 12,796 [Cash_Flow Cell A9448] | -2,062 [Cash_Flow Cell A9474] |
| 2022-12-31 | 10,435 [Cash_Flow Cell A9450] | -1,346 [Cash_Flow Cell A9476] |
| 2023-12-31 | 13,931 [Cash_Flow Cell A9452] | -1,245 [Cash_Flow Cell A9478] |
